usage.source_scope: Twelve PB1-disjoint public Hong Kong building identities, split into six Development and six confirmation entities; one reference and four audited facade/entrance/side/partial queries per entity.
usage.project_application: Establish requested-place identity before spatially assigning the retained functional portal set.
usage.modifications: Use official frozen SALAD and MixVPR checkpoints, whole-image descriptors, a fixed one-reference entity bank, Development-only threshold and arm selection, and explicit wrong-building pairings.
usage.expected_effect: Improve Recall@1 or correct positive acceptance by at least 10 percentage points without raising wrong-building confirmation more than two points or collapsing positive coverage.

evaluation.setup: Source-only audit rejected 12 invalid or mislabeled rows before any model call. Development selected CLIP+DINO as baseline and SALAD as challenger; thresholds and selections were frozen before test. All executable arms ran on measured-faster verified RTX 5060 CUDA.
evaluation.effect: On 24 test queries SALAD scored Recall@1 8/24 versus 9/24, Recall@3 20/24 versus 18/24, and correct acceptance 8/24 versus 12/24. Its source-label negative proxy was 3/120 versus 23/120. MixVPR scored Recall@1 7/24 and accepted 16/24 positives, but its source-label negative proxy was 48/120. Neither arm crossed the coupled identity gate; physical target-absent rejection remains NOT_EVALUABLE because co-visible gallery entities were not exhaustively frozen.
evaluation.claim_boundary: This rejects the frozen B0-B2/C1-C2 single-frame appearance-only place-identity route on one curated public-image cohort. Cross-paired negatives are source-label proxies and physical target-absent rejection is NOT_EVALUABLE. It does not reject VPR generally and establishes no portal ownership, access, traversability, motion, navigation, arrival, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.

evidence.summary: Frozen source, arms, split isolation, scoring, threshold selection, metrics, gate, successor, and claim boundary.
Durable metrics, interpretation, decision, backend receipts, and evidence hashes.
Post-result authority correction: cross-paired negatives are source-label proxies, not exhaustive physical target-absence truth; the gate decision is unchanged.
